column1: # Linux local ForSt-RS per-query best-config table.
#   - Scenario: NexMark LOCAL on the origin Linux box.
#   - Backend: forst-rs-ffm-local only; timer service must be FORSTRS.
#   - Resource budget: 8c/32g TM budget as 2 TaskManagers x 4c/16g.
#   - Parallelism must be 8, with 4 task slots per TaskManager. Per-query
#     tuning is allowed for SQL/backend knobs, but topology is fixed to split.
#   - q6 is listed only for completeness; Flink SQL q6 submission is currently
#     unsupported in this harness and remains excluded from totals.
#   query  profile  topology  maxsec  env_assignments  expected_wall_s  status  note
# `env_assignments` is a space-separated KEY=VALUE list. Use `-` for no explicit
# query-specific knobs. The runner still applies conservative Linux local
#     crates/forst-rs-engine/src/db.rs persistent probe iterator. This is the
#     ForSt-style persistent MergingIterator/seek path for q7/q9/q20 repeated
# The initial values below are the latest Linux-local known-good profile as of
